content.text:
The drawing shows benserazide, with no wedges or hashes, so no stereochemistry is included.

**Chain:** HO–CH2–CH(NH2)–C(=O)–NH–NH–CH2–aryl.

**Ring:** The benzylic carbon attaches at ring carbon C1. Going round the ring from the top-left vertex, the ring carbons are:
- C1: the vertex bonded to the CH2, at the left of the ring.
- C2: bottom-left vertex, bearing OH (the OH at the bottom).
- C3: bottom-right vertex, bearing OH.
- C4: top-right vertex, bearing OH.
- C5 and C6: the remaining two vertices, each CH (C5 is the top vertex, C6 the upper-left vertex).

This is a 2,3,4-trihydroxybenzyl group.

SMILES: NC(CO)C(=O)NNCc1ccc(O)c(O)c1O
